answer_1.quote: This paper addresses this gap by investigating whether LLMs develop neuron-level functional specialization, analogous to cortical localization in the human brain , when exposed to tasks that elicit either memorization or generalization.
answer_1.outputs: The model outputs include answers to in-context inference questions (e.g., 'What color is Vicky?'), arithmetic sums, and plaintext decoding of ciphertext, with behaviors categorized as memorization or generalization.

answer_2.quote: We train binary classifiers to distinguish between memorization and generalization behaviors... Classification performance is evaluated on a held-out test split.
